extracted.intended_audience: State educational agencies (SEAs), local educational agencies (LEAs), eligible community organizations, and other entities applying for ESSA grant funds
extracted.subtask_description: An indexed guide describing allowable uses of ESSA funds and eligible entities for programs (literacy, magnet schools, migrant education, Native Hawaiian education, neglected/delinquent programs, etc.). It lists program-specific activities, eligibility, and constraints applicants must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reform teacher certification and preparation program standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Reforming teacher certification, recertification, licensing, or tenure systems or preparation program standards and approval processes to ensure that teachers have the necessary subject-matter knowledge and teaching skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measures determined by the State may include teacher performance assessments in the academic subjects that teachers teach, to help students meet challenging State academic standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interstate teacher licensure reciprocity (State consortium)
rubrics_metrics.description: Enabling States, as a consortium, to voluntarily develop a process that allows teachers who are licensed or certified in a participating State to teach in other participating States without completing additional licensure or certification requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Voluntary State-developed process to facilitate cross-state teaching without additional requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recruiting, placing, training, and compensating literacy coaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Recruiting, placing, training, and compensating literacy coaches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes developing literacy coach training programs and training literacy coaches; appropriate for SEAs and LEAs serving high-need schools or early childhood programs serving disadvantaged children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Engage families to support literacy development
rubrics_metrics.description: Engaging families and encouraging family literacy experiences and practices to support literacy development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes outreach and family engagement activities to build home literacy practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Train families/caregivers to support adolescent literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Training families and caregivers to support the improvement of adolescent literacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs may target caregivers of adolescents to strengthen home support for reading and writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive literacy instruction plan (grades 6–12)
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing and implementing a comprehensive literacy instruction plan across content areas for children in grades 6 through 12 that serves the needs of all children, including children with disabilities and English learners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan must provide intensive, supplemental, accelerated, and explicit intervention/support in reading and writing for children below grade level; activities provided primarily during the regular school day but may be augmented by after‑school and out‑of‑school instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assess adolescent comprehensive literacy instruction quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessing the quality of adolescent comprehensive literacy instruction as part of a well-rounded education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment of instruction quality is an allowable use to improve literacy outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide planning time for teachers for evidence-based adolescent literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing time for teachers to meet to plan evidence-based adolescent comprehensive literacy instruction to be delivered as part of a well-rounded education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows scheduling/planning supports so teachers can collaborate on instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate multidisciplinary staff for grades 6–12 literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating the involvement of principals, instructional leaders, teachers, teacher literacy teams, ESL specialists (as appropriate), paraprofessionals, special educators, and specialized instructional support personnel in the literacy development of children in grades 6 through 12.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes cross-role coordination to support adolescent literacy, including teams and specialists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connect out-of-school and in-school learning for K–12 literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Connecting out-of-school learning opportunities to in-school learning in order to improve children’s literacy achievement (K–12).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports alignment between extracurricular/after-school programs and classroom instruction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide teacher planning time for K–12 literacy staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing time for teachers (and other literacy staff, such as school librarians or specialized instructional support personnel) to meet to plan comprehensive literacy instruction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicable across K–12 to support coordinated literacy planning among staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Comprehensive literacy instruction plan (K–5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Developing and implementing a comprehensive literacy instruction plan across content areas for children in kindergarten through grade 5 that serves the needs of all children, including children with disabilities and English learners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Should provide intensive, supplemental, accelerated, and explicit intervention and support for children below grade level; primarily during school day but may include out-of-school supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate K–5 literacy staff and specialists
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating the involvement of early childhood education program staff, principals, instructional leaders, teachers, teacher literacy teams, ESL specialists (as appropriate), special educators, school personnel, and specialized instructional support personnel in the literacy development of children in kindergarten through grade 5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaboration across early childhood and elementary roles to support literacy development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthen pre-service coursework in evidence-based literacy methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating with institutions of higher education in the State to provide recommendations to strengthen and enhance pre-service courses for students preparing to teach children from birth through grade 12 in explicit, systematic, and intensive instruction in evidence-based literacy methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SEA coordination with IHEs to influence teacher preparation curricula for literacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publish promising instructional practices publicly
rubrics_metrics.description: Making publicly available, including on the SEA’s website, information on promising instructional practices to improve child literacy achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transparency and dissemination of evidence-based practices to support statewide literacy improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review and update State licensure/certification standards for literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewing and updating, in collaboration with teachers and institutions of higher education, State licensure or certification standards in the area of literacy instruction in early education through grade 12.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Align licensure standards with evidence-based literacy instruction practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form school literacy leadership teams
rubrics_metrics.description: Forming a school literacy leadership team to help implement, assess, and identify necessary changes to the literacy initiatives in one or more schools to ensure success.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: School-level leadership teams to oversee literacy initiative implementation and continuous improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote literacy programs in low-income communities (libraries, materials, PD)
rubrics_metrics.description: Promoting literacy programs that support the development of literacy skills in low-income communities, including developing and enhancing effective school library programs, which may include providing professional development for school librarians, books, and up-to-date materials to high-need schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on resource provision, library improvement, and librarian training targeted to high-need schools and communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pediatric and early literacy outreach through medical providers
rubrics_metrics.description: Promoting early literacy services, including pediatric literacy programs through which, during well-child visits, medical providers trained in research-based methods of early language and literacy promotion provide developmentally appropriate books and recommendations to parents to encourage them to read aloud starting in infancy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrates literacy promotion with health services to reach families from infancy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide high-quality books regularly to low-income children/adolescents
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs that provide high-quality books on a regular basis to children and adolescents from low-income communities to increase reading motivation, performance, and frequency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustained book distribution programs aimed at improving access and motivation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide technical assistance for literacy program design and implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing technical assistance, or engaging qualified providers to provide technical assistance, to eligible entities to enable the eligible entities to design and implement literacy programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may be used to contract expertise to support local program development and implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement a multi-tier system of supports for literacy services
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing for a multi-tier system of supports for literacy services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports tiered intervention frameworks (e.g., universal, targeted, intensive) for literacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Magnet school planning and promotion
rubrics_metrics.description: Planning and promotional activities directly related to the development, expansion, continuation, or enhancement of academic programs and services offered at magnet schools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes capacity-building activities tied to magnet program goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acquire materials and equipment for magnet schools (limited to directly related items)
rubrics_metrics.description: Acquiring books, materials, and equipment, including computers and the maintenance and operation of materials, equipment, and computers, necessary to conduct programs in magnet schools only if the activities are directly related to improving student academic achievement based on challenging State academic standards or improving reading/math/science/social studies/foreign languages/arts or career/technical skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purchases must be directly tied to academic improvement; routine or unrelated acquisitions are not allowable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compensate effective teachers/instructional staff in magnet schools (linked to academic improvement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Compensating, or subsidizing the compensation, of elementary and secondary school teachers who are effective, and instructional staff where applicable, who are necessary to conduct programs in magnet schools only if activities are directly related to improving student academic achievement based on challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compensation supports must be academically focused and directly tied to magnet program delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide magnet curriculum access to non-enrolled students
rubrics_metrics.description: Where magnet school programs are offered to less than the entire student population of a school, the instructional activities that are designed to make available the special curriculum that is offered by the magnet school program to students who are enrolled in the school but who are not enrolled in the magnet school program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensures equitable access to specialized magnet curricula within host schools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capacity-building activities for magnet program sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities, which may include professional development, that will build the recipient’s capacity to operate magnet school programs once the grant period has ended.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on sustainability and institutionalization of magnet program practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative flexibility for magnet programs to serve non-enrolled students
rubrics_metrics.description: Enabling the LEA, or consortium, to have more flexibility in the administration of a magnet school program in order to serve students attending a school who are not enrolled in a magnet school program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows administrative design choices to extend magnet benefits within districts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design flexibility for magnet schools across all grades
rubrics_metrics.description: Enabling the LEA, or consortium, to have flexibility in designing magnet schools for students in all grades.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports grade-span design decisions responsive to local context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish/expand interdistrict and regional magnet programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Enabling LEAs, consortia, or partner organizations to establish, expand, or strengthen interdistrict and regional magnet programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages cross-district collaboration to broaden magnet program reach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide sustainable transportation for magnet students
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing transportation to and from the magnet school, provided that such transportation is sustainable beyond the grant period, and the costs of providing transportation do not represent a significant portion of the grant funds received by the eligible LEA.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transportation is allowed only if sustainable and not a major share of grant funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentoring programs aligned to standards and curricula
rubrics_metrics.description: Mentoring programs that are aligned with the challenging State academic standards and any local academic standards; and local curricula that are designed to improve student academic achievement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentoring must be academically focused and tied to standards/curriculum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Family literacy services for migratory children with low-literacy parents
rubrics_metrics.description: Offering family literacy services if the program or project serves a substantial number of migratory children whose parents do not have a high school diploma or its recognized equivalent or who have low levels of literacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets family literacy where parental educational levels suggest need.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy and outreach for migratory children and families
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing advocacy and other outreach activities for migratory children and their families, including helping such children and families gain access to other education, health, nutrition, and social services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support services and referral/coordination activities to address holistic needs of migratory families.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development and mentoring for migratory/NH program staff
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing professional development programs, including mentoring, for teachers and other program personnel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PD can address unique needs of migratory children or Native Hawaiian students and strengthen program delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: High-quality, comprehensive programs for migratory children (school year & summer)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting high-quality and comprehensive educational programs and services during the school year and, as applicable, during summer or intersession periods, that address the unique educational needs of migratory children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs should be based on migratory students' specific needs and may include extended learning opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs/projects based on State comprehensive needs assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs and projects based on the State's comprehensive assessment of needs for services in the State, including the acquisition of equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State-level needs assessment should drive program selection and allowable purchases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote interstate/intrastate coordination for migratory children
rubrics_metrics.description: Promoting interstate and intrastate coordination of services for migratory children, including providing for educational continuity through the timely transfer of pertinent school records, including information on health, when children move from one school to another.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordination ensures continuity of education and services across moves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate with other programs to benefit migratory children
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinating with similar programs and projects within the State and in other States, as well as with other Federal programs that can benefit migratory children and their families.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interprogram collaboration to leverage resources and services is allowable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrate information technology into educational programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing for the integration of information technology into educational and related programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports tech integration to enhance learning and program delivery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate transition to postsecondary education or employment
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing programs to facilitate the transition of secondary school students to postsecondary education or employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes counseling, dual enrollment, CTE, and other transition-focused strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve credit accrual/exchange for migratory children
rubrics_metrics.description: Improving the interstate and intrastate coordination of migrant education activities, including through the establishment or improvement of programs for credit accrual and exchange available to migratory children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps migratory students maintain progress toward graduation despite moves.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monitoring programs and activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Monitoring programs and activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes program oversight, compliance monitoring, and evaluation activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop academic and vocational curricula for Native Hawaiian education
rubrics_metrics.description: The development of academic and vocational curricula to address the needs of Native Hawaiian children and adults, including curriculum materials in the Hawaiian language and mathematics and science curricula that incorporate Native Hawaiian tradition and culture.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curricula should be culturally relevant and include language-appropriate materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services for Native Hawaiian students with disabilities (IDEA-consistent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities to meet the special needs of Native Hawaiian students with disabilities, including the identification of such students and their needs; the provision of support services to the families of such students; and other activities consistent with the requirements of the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services must align with IDEA requirements and support family engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operate community-based learning centers for Native Hawaiians
rubrics_metrics.description: The operation of community-based learning centers that address the needs of Native Hawaiian students, parents, families, and communities through the coordination of public and private programs and services, including early childhood education programs; before/after/summer programs; expanded learning time; career and technical education; and programs that incorporate qualified Native Hawaiian elders and seniors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Centers should coordinate services, be culturally responsive, and serve broad community needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop statewide Native Hawaiian early education and care system
rubrics_metrics.description: Development and maintenance of a statewide Native Hawaiian early education and care system to provide a continuum of services for Native Hawaiian children from the prenatal period through age 5.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: System-level planning to ensure service continuity across early childhood stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operate family-based education centers (prenatal to age 3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation of family-based education centers that provide services such as programs for Native Hawaiian parents and their infants from the prenatal period through age 3; preschool programs for Native Hawaiians; and research on, and development and assessment of, family-based early childhood programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports family-centered early learning and relevant research activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance beginning reading/literacy in Hawaiian or English (K–3 and grades 5–6 support)
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities that enhance beginning reading and literacy in either the Hawaiian or the English language among Native Hawaiian students in kindergarten through grade 3 and assistance in addressing the distinct features of combined English and Hawaiian literacy for Hawaiian speakers in grades 5 and 6.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports bilingual literacy approaches and targeted interventions where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Address needs of gifted and talented Native Hawaiian students
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities that address the special needs of Native Hawaiian students who are gifted and talented, including educational, psychological, and developmental activities designed to assist in the educational progress of those students; and activities that involve the parents of those students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes enrichment, support services, and family involvement strategies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postsecondary readiness activities for Native Hawaiian students
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities, including program co-location, to enable Native Hawaiians to enter and complete programs of postsecondary education, including family literacy services; and counseling, guidance, and support services for students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports co-location and counseling aimed at postsecondary access and completion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and data collection on Native Hawaiian educational needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Research and data collection activities to determine the educational status and needs of Native Hawaiian children and adults.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funds may support needs assessments and program evaluation research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Native Hawaiian research and evaluation activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Other research and evaluation activities related to programs carried out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports evaluation to inform program improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other activities consistent with Native Hawaiian program purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: Other activities, consistent with the purposes of this program, to meet the educational needs of Native Hawaiian children and adults.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Catch-all for permissible activities aligned with program goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet educational needs of neglected and delinquent children and youth
rubrics_metrics.description: Meeting the educational needs of children and youth in institutions for neglected or delinquent children and youth; attending community day programs for neglected or delinquent children and youth; or in adult correctional institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs may be operated by SEAs or in partnership with other agencies to serve institutionalized youth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs/projects consistent with State plan (neglected/delinquent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs and projects consistent with the State plan, including the acquisition of equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State plan alignment required; equipment purchases allowed if tied to plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transition programs for secondary students to postsecondary/CTE (neglected/delinquent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs and projects that concentrate on providing participants with the knowledge and skills needed to make a successful transition to secondary school completion, career and technical education, further education, or employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes transitional supports, CTE linkages, and skills development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow pay-for-success initiatives (neglected/delinquent)
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs and projects that may include pay-for-success initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permits innovative financing models where outcomes-based contracts are used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted services for youth with dual system contact
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs and projects that may include providing targeted services for youth who have come in contact with both the child welfare system and juvenile justice system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses complex needs of multiply-involved youth with tailored supports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support educational services for children identified as failing or most at-risk
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs designed to support educational services that are provided to children and youth identified by the State agency as failing, or most at-risk of failing, to meet the challenging State academic standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted interventions for the highest-need youth populations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upgrade entire educational effort of an institution serving neglected/delinquent youth
rubrics_metrics.description: Upgrading the entire educational effort of an institution for neglected or delinquent children and youth (other than an adult correctional institution) or a community-day program if the State agency has developed, and the SEA has approved, a comprehensive plan for that institution or program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive institutional improvement permitted with SEA-approved plan.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilitate transition between state institutions and local schools
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting projects that facilitate the transition of children and youth between State-operated institutions, or institutions in the State operated by the Secretary of the Interior, and schools served by LEAs or schools operated or funded by the Bureau of Indian Education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transition supports to ensure educational continuity for youth returning to local schools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support reentry of youth offenders into postsecondary or CTE
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting the successful reentry of youth offenders, age 20 or younger and who have received a regular high school diploma or its equivalent, into postsecondary education or career and technical training programs through strategies like preplacement programs that allow adjudicated or incarcerated youth to audit or attend courses on college campuses, or through programs provided in institutional settings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes preplacement access, institutional postsecondary programs, and partnerships with colleges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worksite school partnerships for reentry
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting reentry through worksite schools in which institutions of higher education and private or public employers partner to create programs to help students transition to postsecondary education and employment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Partnership models linking education providers and employers are allowable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential support services for youth reentry
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting reentry through essential support services to ensure success, which may include personal, career and technical, and academic counseling; placement services to place youth in university/college programs; information and assistance obtaining student financial aid; counseling services; and job placement services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive wraparound supports to promote successful postsecondary/CTE outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support returning students from correctional facilities to remain in school
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs that serve children and youth returning to local schools from correctional facilities, to assist in the transition of such children and youth to the school environment and help them remain in school in order to complete their education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transition and retention-focused supports for reentering students.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dropout prevention programs for at-risk youth
rubrics_metrics.description: Dropout prevention programs which serve at-risk children and youth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interventions aimed at keeping at-risk students engaged and on track to graduate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate health and social services to improve educational outcomes
rubrics_metrics.description: The coordination of health and social services for individuals if there is a likelihood that the provision of such services (including day care, drug and alcohol counseling, and mental health services) will improve the likelihood such individuals will complete their education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permits integrated supports where non-academic services are necessary for educational persistence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentoring and peer mediation programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs providing mentoring and peer mediation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Behavioral and social supports that complement academic interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special programs to meet unique academic needs (CTE, special ed, entrepreneurship)
rubrics_metrics.description: Special programs to meet unique academic needs of participating children and youth, including career and technical education, special education, career counseling, curriculum-based youth entrepreneurship education, and assistance in securing student loans or grants for postsecondary education.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broad set of programmatic supports addressing academic and career readiness and financial access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programs for at-risk Indian children and youth (including correctional facilities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs for at-risk Indian children and youth, including such children and youth in correctional facilities in the area served by the LEA that are operated by the Secretary of the Interior or Indian tribes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted services for Indian youth, including those in tribal or federal correctional settings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Services to children in local neglected/delinquent institutions and community day programs
rubrics_metrics.description: Providing services to children in local institutions for neglected children, children in local institutions for delinquent children, and neglected or delinquent children in community day programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local program delivery to institutionalized or community-served neglected/delinquent youth.
